notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/cc18f2d59193d063e8780fc3951e9bd8bec6b58c.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

Hope you are all doing fine! After a strange chaotic year with hard lockdowns and working from home, things are slowly returning (a bit) to normal in our country. We are still hard at work on the new Security update 0.1.2. Last time we shared some information about the new lockpicking system. The largest changes we are making for this new update are on the detection system and the Guards/SWAT AI. We can’t wait to share more about these game-changing reworks, but I'm afraid it still needs some time in the oven. It is going to be worth it tho! 

So we have some other cool stuff to share in the meantime. Once again it is time to tell you about a rework we did on an existing system. It is one of my personal favorites so far and it will have a big impact on how the game plays out: the new Health system!

[b][i]PLEASE NOTE: The content in this blog is a preview of what is to come, and can not be found in the live version of the game just yet. It will be added when the next update (0.1.2) is released.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=lqz0MVr4oDU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Health System[/h1]

Before we begin, let's bring up how the current/old system works. There was always a health present system in the game, but it was not so obviously present. The player had a set amount of health (which was not visible to the player) and could receive damage from guards and SWAT. The old system worked with regeneration. If you did not receive any damage for a set amount of time, your health would regenerate to full. While it worked in the beginning, it felt very easy to get into a fight. It made it more appealing to start a fight than to sneak past a guard. You would only die if you would get hit in quick succession, and even after you won the firefight, it had not any big impact on the rest of your game, since you automatically heal up to full. This method basically gave you unlimited health.    

The new system fully changes how your health works.[b] The player still has a set amount of health, but it will not automatically regenerate over time.[/b] Every time the player takes damage, it will stay until the player heals themselves at a certain point. This also means that we will be adding different methods for the player to heal. This new health system will greatly change the way you need to play the game. Your health is now limited for each heist, so every time you get hit will have consequences for the rest of your mission. Every time you get into a combat situation, you now need to keep an eye on both your health and ammo.  

We will share more about the upcoming Guards and SWAT rework in the following dev posts,[b] but we can already share that, in the 0.1.2 update, it will be possible to lose sight during a fight.[/b] This means that you will be able to rehide again from guards and Swat once the alarm has been raised. This will give the player a big window of opportunity to restock on ammo and health and to get ready for the next possible flight. 

Panther VR is at its core a stealth-focused game, and we think that giving the player a more limited amount of health, with a combination of healing, increases the motivation to focus more on a stealthy approach. The amount of health and healing the player receives will be more than enough to support the firefights after getting spotted, and it will always give the option to use a more violent approach, but hiding becomes way more powerful. 

With the new health system comes also a better visualization of your health. The player will have their watch back which includes information about their health. You can find this information located on the wrist. It currently shows 2 bars. The top one is your current health, and the second one is your available healing. Your health bar will be green if you are at and near full health. It will turn orange if you are wounded, and red if you are critical/near death.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=MDaMBbYUZ34;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Syringe[/h1]

One of the different ways you can heal yourself is with the use of a syringe. The syringe is always part of your basic kit and has its own new slot located on your arm with the watch. You can grab the syringe with an empty hand. Once held you can stab the syringe in your other hand or straight up in your body/chest to heal yourself. 

So how does healing work with the syringe? The syringe holds charges that the player can use to heal themselves. Each charge contains enough to heal the player to full. And the amount of charge that is not used, will remain there for later use. In the example video, the syringe only contains one charge. In this case, if the player has only 60% health, and 100% charge, you will only use up 40% charge to heal you up to full. 

Once the syringe is used you can release it to return it to your arm. Keep in mind that once the syringe has been used, it will need to recharge for several seconds before it can be used again. So you have to pick the right moment to choose

[previewyoutube=2YyPLRs_HP8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Healing Station[/h1]

Besides using the syringe, there are also other ways to heal yourself. One of these methods is to look for a Healing Station. These stations will randomly spawn across the heist locations. They are fully unlocked and accessible to the player and will open automatically once in range. The Station contains one full healing charge. You can start the healing process by grabbing the lever inside of the machine. The machine will start healing you over time until it's empty. 

You can stop the process at any time, and you will be even able to use your other hand to shoot guards while healing up. The station will display your personal stats in combination with its own charge level. Once the healing station is empty it will automatically close and can not be used again. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=M7YL4hK12dE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Healing Items[/h1]

We are also adding a new loot item. The First aid can be found around the level, and will instantly heal the player for 25%. So search around in drawers and lockers for a nice health bonus. For now, we start with only the first aid kit. But more items can/will be added in future updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[previewyoutube=7AhF06HFJ2c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Over Heal[/h1]

If you take some damage and use up your syringe, there comes a point that you might be running out of healing. This is where overheal comes into play. When your syringe is not fully stocked you can refill its charges with the healing station and first aid kits. For now, this will only happen if you are fully healed. All excess healing will fill up your syringe for later use. With this feature, you can restock at the healing station or save the first aid kits for later use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]
We are really looking forward to your reactions to this new health System. Our goal is to make stealth more valuable while also making the combat more tactical. We've already played heist with the new system, and it already feels like you are going to need a whole new approach to the game. We can't wait to test it out! 

- Jesse

notes.title: Panther VR - Dev Blog 11# [New LockPicking System]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/c2420c6888ae2e2570072b69430a57cd8332234f.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

Hope you are all doing fine! We can look back to the first update 0.1.1 with great pleasure and pride. We received a lot of positive feedback and support from the community on our first big update. This shows that we are on the right track and makes us even more motivated and eager to bring you new content and updates. The community keeps growing and can't get enough of your feedback and suggestions! 

Now with the first update behind us it is time to look for the next one. We are hard at work on the 0.1.2 update, and we can’t wait to show you some stuff we have been working on.

The next update will mainly focus on the full rework of the guards and detection system. This will take some time to fully implement, but we are also working on new content on the side that will also arrive to the game with the next update. However, since we laid out a more solid base with the 0.1.1 update, the next update can be expected way sooner this time around! 

So before we show you more on the guards, we will move to one of our new mechanics to the game, one that was already present in the Kickstarter Demo: Lockpicking!

[b][i]PLEASE NOTE: The content in this blog is a preview of what is to come, and can not be found in the live version of the game just yet. It will be added when the next update (0.1.2) is released.[/i][/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=cOT6Yo-sYAg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]LOCKPICKING[/h1]

A stealth game would not be complete without lockpicking. It was one of the first things we had in our Kickstarter Demo, but now is returning with the 0.1.2 update! With this new mechanic, the player will be able to pick locks with their new lockpick set. These locks can be found on strongboxes, which spawn randomly around the whole level. 

In the live version of the game, you can find valuable loot all over the level, but it would make more sense that people are locking away their valuables in safe locations. So with this new mechanic you can lock pick these strongboxes to gain access to higher value loot, while lower value loot can still be found more scarlessly around the level. 

There were a lot of things to consider while developing the Lockpicking mechanic. We are looking for a fine balance between realism, functionality, replayability and fun. That is how we came up with what you see in this post. So let me share with you how it works. 

First the player needs to walk up to a lock. If the player has any lockpicks in their inventory can start the process by grabbing the lockpick. Now it is up to the player to find the right spot by twisting and turning the Lockpick. Once you find the hotspot with audio/visual/rumble cues, you can press the trigger to unlock the lock and open the strongbox. However be careful with the lockpick, if you go too fast you might miss the right spot, and your lockpick will break.  


We also want to make sure that lockpick will always be optional, as like every stealth option in the game. You are not required to pick these strong boxes, but you will be well rewarded if you succeed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[previewyoutube=OIbqgnSQ1l4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]LOCKPICK DIFFICULTY[/h1]

The lockpick mechanic is fast to learn. As long as you stay out of sight during the lockpick you should be able to break open an easy lock with some ease. However you will find different and more difficult strongboxes and lock around the level. The strong boxes will come in 3 different levels, each harder to crack and with more precious loot inside. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=jXM2xjTOGH8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]AMMO LOCKER[/h1]

These strong boxes are not the only thing you can lockpick in the game. In the current version of the game it can be very difficult to find new ammo once you run out. That is why we are also adding Ammo lockers to the game. These lockers can randomly be found around the heist location and always contain ammo for your weapon. You can lock pick these Ammo lockers to gain access to new ammo. But in case you are in a real hurry (say firefight) you can always shoot your way in. This is not recommended in stealth since an alarm will sound when you breach this locker with force.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=454hKYTipgY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]LOCKPICKS[/h1]

We are also adding an extra inventory to store your lockpicks. You can always check in you backpack how much you are carrying. Lockpick automatically moves into the locks, but you need to keep an eye on your lockpick amount if you want to break into multiple Lockers. Before you start your mission you can stock up on lockpicks, but there is always a possibility to find a new lockpick during your heist. You can put them in your backpack to refill your lockpicks. Gameplay testing and community input is required to determine a fair amount of lockpicks for the player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[previewyoutube=GSbq1e-H62o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]LOOT MARKERS[/h1]

We are also adding extra Loot Markers to drawers or lockers that may contain loot. This will help to find location where you might find loot, and will also indicate if you already robbed it clean from anything valuable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]
We hope you like what you see so far. We would love to hear what you think about the new mechanic and what kind of things you would like to see lockpicked. The 0.1.2 update will be filled with new content like this, and can’t wait to show to the next mechanic that we are working on besides the guard. We can only share that there will be some big changes to health coming up! More on this in our next dev blog!

- Jesse

notes.title: Panther VR Interaction Update now Available - Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/ab4af9e336dffa1a0a555770b94478e10fb797bd.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/be1d6c264632ba6f53d978fa72d36b3ad7f79e10.png[/img]

[h1]A New start for Panther VR![/h1]

Hi Everyone,

It has been a strange year for us all. The world is still different than it was one year ago,[b] but after months of hard work, we can finally reveal the new and first update (0.1.1) for Panther VR! The Interaction update includes a lot of system reworks, fixes, performance updates, and even some new features and mechanics![/b] It has been quite the ride for our 2 man team these past few months, but we are proud of what we have achieved and we can’t wait to see what you think! 

[b]Panther VR is still our passion project and we have so many ideas for the future of the game, like new mechanics, levels, weapons, gadgets, security systems, etc. [/b]We would love to maybe explore the possibility of co-op or to bring the game to the Quest. (but that is a future talk for now). So you must imagine that 2020  started great after the Kickstarter for Panther VR! While we were extremely grateful that we could start working on this project, the whole Covid situation quickly changed that forecast. It put a big strain on our workforce and budget. The whole situation forced our hand to bring Panther VR to Steam Early Access last year.

While we were happy that we could finally bring Panther VR to the public last year, the release left us with a bad taste. [b]We were not satisfied with the state and quality of the game on our first EA release, and it did not bring to life what we had in mind for the game. [/b]Sure, the general gameplay was present, but the controller and interaction (the basic foundation of a VR game) was broken and incomplete. So we quickly made a plan for ourselves after that initial release. 

Instead of working on a new update to add more content to an incomplete foundation, we wanted to start over with a clean slate as you would say. [b] To bring Panther to a higher quality level for VR as you would see in current VR titles.[/b] So we began a long journey to remake Panther to a level that we are proud of, and is worthy of our amazing community. While Covid did not make things easier for us, and it took more time than expected, we pushed onward and we are ready to give you this first update for Panther VR!

The interaction update brings a[b] full rework of the interaction [/b]with the world around you, with new and improved hands and animation. Move, run, crouch, and vault with the [b]new Movement system[/b]. Store items and gadgets in your backpack, and weapons on your belt with the[b] new Inventory system. [/b]Reload your weapons with the new[b] physical reloading and ammo system.[/b] Get yourself started in the game with the[b] new introduction and tutorial level.[/b] Plus many more: [b]like performance increases, Spectator camera, and new headset supports including Quest 2 for PC.[/b]

[b]We want to thank you all for your patience and amazing support for this project. This first update will be a new start for Panther VR! [/b]It has so much potential and we believe in an amazing future for this project! 2021 will be a lot better with more amazing new content and updates after this fresh new update!

Have fun!

[b]-Wolfdog Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/26343e6f4cf67f394cd8619df4cf85e1ea7007c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]Why did it take longer than expected?[/h1]

[h3]- Covid Situation[/h3]
The lockdowns and curfews took a big toll on our development process. The whole dev process was forced on a pause for almost a month, and when we were finally able to work from home, it did not make things a lot easier.

I myself tested positive for covid in late October and was forced into complete isolation for almost a month. I’m really grateful that my symptoms were not so severe, but recovery took some time. 

[h3]- Total rework of everything we got[/h3]
We removed the old interaction system, and build and integrated a new one from the ground up. Work that was necessary for the future of the game. We could not build the whole game on the old broken system, so a new system was required for future updates and we added some new mechanics in the process as well. In Addition to the big rework, we also updated the engine of the game. 

[h3]- Small team of 2 People[/h3]
our team only consists of 2 people. While we have a lot of people surrounding and supporting us, the real work comes down to just the two of us. (including me) We broke down the plans into “smaller’ steps in our roadmap. But even these smaller steps take a lot of time with 2. Especially the huge amount of rework we did for this new update. 


[h3]- Some side jobs[/h3]
We are not a large company with unlimited resources. So we needed to do some small side jobs to keep working on this passion project possible. There are still bills that need to be paid.  We wish could work full time on this project, and we still hope that this will change in the future. :)

[b]Read More: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864730/view/2919985155802467583]Panther VR - Dev Blog 10# [Upcoming Update][/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[h1] What is coming for the future?[/h1]
Now that this first update is up and running we can finally focus on the future of Panther VR. Since the moment we started this project our list of stuff and content we wanted to see for this game kept growing. And with this new foundation to the game, we can start to look at that long list and bring new content and mechanics to the game! Our goal is to bring more frequent updates to Panther VR this year!

[h3]Next update: 0.1.2 Security Update[/h3]
After we did a full rework on the interaction, there is still one big part of the game that we would love to change up. The guard AI and the way the different detection levels are handled are on the top of your priority list. The guards in the current version of the game are still using an old and dumbed-down AI system. In this next update, we want to rework how detection works, making guards more independent by bringing out their own search parties and giving the option to return a full alert back to normal with different and more steps between not detected and full alert. More information about this in an upcoming dev blog!

[b][list]
[*] AI Rework Guards and SWAT
[*] New Detection system
[*] New  Weapons and gadgets
[*] Return of Lockers and lockpicking!
[*] More to come!
[/list][/b]

[url=http://www.wolfdoginteractive.com/panther-vr-roadmap/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f48a4a570dd8dba402bfe5fa6185e464c411efe9.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/529dd17623bd874a9c01448782103a5c4ab630e9.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Interaction System [REWORK] [/h1]

Interaction is core for any VR game. That is was missing the most in the first version of Panther VR. That is why we did a full overhaul of the interactions system. We removed the old clunky arms and replaced them with responsive hands. 

One of the biggest changes however is the item interaction. You are now able to fully grasp the items you pick up. Every item has its unique pose while grabbing, so no more floating items or strangely placed fingers. We’ve also added full physics to each item, so you will be able to knock stuff over or build small towers out of soda cans. It is still possible to grab objects once your hands are near them, but we also reworked the ranged system as well. Complimented by a GUI and hover over the indicator, items will now float smoothly into your hands once you grab them from a distance. 

[b]Functionality:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Operations Center:[/b] Select missions (more functions added in future updates)
[/list]

[b]Read More: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864730/view/2910969711787182295]Panther VR - Dev Blog 6# [Interaction Rework][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/edfe28f2791b8c4dd31429e0c1f4ba97d4930bff.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Inventory System[/h1]

Introducing: the Backpack! The Backpack serves as a physical inventory system in which you can store items, melee weapons, and Loot. The Backpack is located behind your head and can be grabbed by holding down the grip button.

Inside your Backpack you can find a certain amount of slots for Items and melee weapons, sorted into different tabs. You can bring all small items with you, including Melee weapons and loot. So next time you come across a guard, there might be something very useful in your backpack.

We also included a Quick store and Auto store function for the backpack. When you grab the backpack, you can also put items in the auto slot at the top which are automatically stored in the first empty slot. For even more convenience you can also use the Quick store function. Without holding the backpack, you can just grab and put an item behind your head to automatically store it in your backpack!

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Backpack as inventory behind your head[/b]
[*] [b]Store Items and loot in different tabs[/b]
[*] [b]Quick store items directly in the backpack by holding it behind your head [/b]
[/list]

[b]Read More: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864730/view/2910969711809008239]Panther VR - Dev Blog 7# [New Backpack System][/url]

[previewyoutube=epYMYid2bLY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/91a25965b43f0de6bece7241da447f4a1a7079ab.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Movement System [REWORK] [/h1]

We have reworked our movement systems to smooth out the old system, and we added additional systems like running, vaulting, and crouching. Making it easier to navigate around.

[h3]Running[/h3]
We now added the option to sprint. YOu can move faster by pushing both the thumbstick forward. At this time you can sprint indefinitely and without making a sound. But this will change in the future.

[h3]Vaulting[/h3]
You can now vault over or jump on waist height objects. It uses the same controls as running, making it also possible to quickly vault over stuff while running.

[h3]Crouching[/h3]
In addition, to actually physically crouching down, we also added the option to press to auto crouch. This will lower the player to crouch height, making it easier to move through air vent or to hide behind cover, without crouching yourself. You can press on the thumbstick to crouch down.

[b]Read More: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864730/view/2894083751400589410]Panther VR - Dev Blog 9# [New Movement System][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/70997009a5e69155c7dcbfaa4deafd45a56ca14f.png[/img]

[h1]Added: Weapon Interaction[/h1]

Based on our own experience in the game and on a lot of feedback from the community we decided to give this system a full overhaul. While the old system was more fast-paced, we are moving to a more “realistic approach” with a physical weapons system. All your weapons will be stored on your body/belt and the quick select system will be removed from the game. We have added 2 belt slots (left/right) for small firearms, and a large weapon slot on your back/ You can quickly draw and store your gun and Rifle. 

Next up is physical reloading and handling. Then you need to grab a new clip from your ammo belt (instead of moving the weapon to your belt) and physically put the new mag in your weapon. Once inserted, you need to pull back the slide of your weapons to put a bullet in the chamber. You can eject a mag or cock your gun whenever you want.

[*] [b]Added Physical Reloading[/b]

[/list]

[b]Read More: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/864730/view/2910970981466403299]Panther VR - Dev Blog 8# [New Weapons System][/url]

[h1]Added: Tutorial level[/h1]
In the old version of Panther, you were instantly thrown into the game without any information whatsoever on what to do or who you are. That is why we are adding a Tutorial level. This level serves as an introduction to the story and the game for first-time players. 

When you start the game for the first time after this update, you will go through the introduction. This consist of the following things:

[h3]First-time Setup[/h3]
We have added a first-time setup screen in order to select your movement preference for the game. This will make the available options more present and will let you choose how you want to play the game. It is an easy and quick setup with information on different playstyles. You can change everything later in the options menu. 

[h3]Story Introduction[/h3]
Next up is the story introduction. We have a lot of ideas and lore ready for the Panther VR universe. We hope that this introduction will set the stage for who you are in the game, and introduces your fellow team members and characters.

[h3]Tutorial Level[/h3]
There will also be a tutorial/training session that will teach you all about the current mechanics of the game. Each step will learn how you use your weapons, how security works, and how to complete a mission. So that when you start your first heist, you know what to expect! This also introduces you to our new ingame character: Z, the Hacker of the Crew (voiced by Joe Goffney)

This will make the footage on-screen much better to look at or to capture for youtube or twitch. We set an optimal setting for the game, but you can freely adjust the FOV and smoothness level.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/bb211866b6be02b75d3292de0a72eef68c5342b2.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

Hope you are all still safe and sound. It has been some hectic and eventful months for all of us. While it has been a while that we posted a dev post, we are very eager to share with you some more information about our progress and status!

In the previous dev blogs, we discussed some new features and mechanics we are adding to the game with the new update. However in this new dev blog, we will share some more insight into the development process of the new update, and why it is taking longer than expected. We will also share some more information about the 0.1.1 update that is coming up soon, and to wrap it all up, we have some small new stuff to show and tease!


First of all, let’s talk about the development process of the new update. Since the release in July, we have been working really hard on the first big update. While we received a lot of positive feedback and suggestions since the release, we personally were not fully satisfied with the status of the game. 2020 already started as a mess, and the whole covid situation forced our hands to aim for an Early Access release in July. While we did everything we could to wrap things up for EA release, it still did not meet our high demands we set for ourselves and the community. So immediately after release, we set up a roadmap and a plan to work toward that version of Panther VR that we all want to see. We can tell with full certainty that we are still fully motivated to reach that goal, and the 0.1.1 update will be the first big step in the right direction! However, reaching that goal will take some time and it’s that development time I want to talk about. Because why is the new update taking so long? 
We will share some points about our process that will hopefully answer that question.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]Why is the Update taking longer than expected?[/h1]

[h2]Covid-19[/h2]
So let’s start with the elephant in the room: the covid situation. [b]While we are very lucky that everybody close to us is still healthy, and we also hope that everyone reading this and their relatives are also safe and sound. [/b]The whole of 2020 has been a year with a lot of downsides. The lockdowns took a big toll on our development process. The whole dev process was forced on a pause for almost a month, and when we were finally able to work from home, it did not make things a lot easier. Working on a game project is a very creative process, and working separately does not improve the situation. 

If that wasn’t enough,[b] I myself tested positive for covid in late October and was forced into complete isolation for 2 weeks.[/b] I’m really grateful that my symptoms were not so severe, but let just say that my bed was my best friend for that period. I’m fully recovered now, and really glad that I did not spread the virus to anyone else. So while we had a bit of a setback this year with covid, it never broke our spirit and we still kept working on the game.

[h2]Big first update[/h2]
One of the main reasons we were not satisfied with the 0.1.0 version of Panther VR is the interaction system. The hands were really awkward, there was no real interaction with the world. Items float in your hands and the fingers did not even move right. And let’s not start about the horrible inflatable noodle arms. Needless to say, it was time for a good rework. So that is what we did. [b]We removed the old interaction system, and build and integrated a new one from the ground up.[/b] This completely broke the player’s character and everything that the player could interact with: guards, security, etc. Meaning that almost every system in the game has to be partially reworked as well. You might imagine that took a lot of extra work. Work that was necessary for the future of the game. We could not build the whole game on the old broken system, so a new system was required for future updates and we added some new mechanics in the process as well. While it took a lot of extra time, we are very happy with the results we also shared in previous dev posts. It gives a whole new feeling to the game and brings Panther VR to a level you might expect of current VR games.  

[b]In Addition to the big rework, we also updated the engine of the game. [/b]When the production of Panther VR started, we built it in an older version of the Unity engine. During the dev process, they made a large update to that engine with a lot of improvements to VR optimization. This rework allowed us to update the engine as well. This update process broke the whole VR implementation to that game, and that needed some rework as well. It should improve the FPS for a lot of systems and it will implement support for all major HMDs. 

[h2]Small Team[/h2]
While the update required a lot of work, we can do so much each month with the team we have. We wanted to work with a bigger team on Panther VR, but due to Covid and limited resources, [b]our team only consists of  2 people.[/b] While we have a lot of people surrounding and supporting us, the real work comes down to just the two of us. (including me) We still have some big plans for Panther VR, and we are still looking at options to expand our production size. In the meantime, we broke down the plans into “smaller’ steps in our roadmap. But even these smaller steps take a lot of time with 2. Especially the huge amount of rework we did for this new update. We can only hope that the next updates will proceed faster and will feature fewer amounts of pandemics. 


So hopefully that shines a light on why it took a bit longer than expected. If we had a bigger team, we would have loved to give you the update a lot sooner. But we want to make sure that we are doing things the right way. And while it will take some extra time and a few more updates to get Panther VR where we want it to be, I’m sure it will be worth the wait!

notes.title: Panther VR - Dev Blog 9# [New Movement System]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/3e2b329a91d512020bef4bbd341718120e3c479a.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

We are making a lot of progress on the first big update. While we have a lot of new features ready and working, due to the size of the update, we still need a bit more time before we can put the ready stamp on it. However, we are still super excited to share some more insights on what we are working on. Today, we share some more information about the work we did on the movement system. So let’s keep going and dive right in!

As a master Thief, moving around the heist location is key to the success of your mission. Since we have an open level and we allow the player to choose their own path, we must have a movement system that compliments your actions. We already had a base for our movement system, but after playtesting and community suggestions, we decided to add some more features and tweaks to the current system.

First up is the basis of all your movement: walking. In the current version of Panther VR you could move your character forward with a maximum and consistent speed. This old system would let you zip around cameras and guards without being noticed. That is why, in the new system, we reduced your basic movement speed, but added the option to sprint. If you push your rotation (offhand) joystick forward, you can now sprint with increased speed. 
This sprint helps you a lot if you want to move quickly around the level or run away from combat. The sprinting system also lays out the framework for player-created sound. Meaning, that while sprinting will get you there faster, it could also create noise for the guard and security system to hear. This noise feature is definitely on our list, but we might need to move it to update 0.1.3. (Guards update)

[h1]OLD MOVEMENT SYSTEM[/h1]
[previewyoutube=UNHTD1dwTQA;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[h1]NEW RUNNING SYSTEM[/h1]
[previewyoutube=6-9l0fs-fYM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

In combination with the Running system, we’ve also added a new vaulting system. In the current version of Panther VR, if you are standing next to a crate, it was not uncommon that you accidentally pushed your character on top of that crate. Resulting in more frustration than actual convenience. While on the other hand, small fences, where unpassable. When you push your rotation (offhand) joystick forward, you can now vault over hip height objects. Giving you way more control, over when you want to vault over fences or stand on crates. 
Specialty in combination with running, this system gives you freerunning feel when you quickly jump over fences and boxes.


[h1]VAULT SYSTEM[/h1]
[previewyoutube=uCTKRxD5h5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

In order to hide for guards or to get to hidden places around the level, you might need to crouch (a lot) in Panther VR. While crouching is a thing you can do IRL in VR, it might not be something you want (or able) to do all the time. That is why we also added a press to the crouch button to Panther VR. Just simply press your rotation (offhand) joystick to enable crouch, and press it again to disable. Once crouched, you can easily hide behind crates or make use of the air vents. Keep in mind that sprinting will always cancel out your crouch position

[h1]CROUCH BUTTON[/h1]
[previewyoutube=-VtD8I5603g;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

Climbing was always a big part of Panther VR. It adds an extra layer of freedom to exploration and traversal of levels. So while working on the movement system, we also smoothed out the climbing system a bit more. We removed most of the climbing bugs and we paved out the framework for more advanced climbing systems for future updates, including zip lines and more grappling hook mechanics. 


[h1]CLIMBING[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Yck8Qq4I0us;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


We know that every player has their own preference when it comes to movement systems, and especially when it comes to turning. Some prefer snap turning, while others live for smooth options. For all those different player preferences, we want to provide options to set up your own way of playing the game. We already had an options menu in the game, which was located on the player’s watch. Now, the menu is accessible with the press of a button and has a fresh new design, with some new options to tinker with. Tailoring the game to your own preferences is a big priority for us, so expect more options for future updates. 

[h1]OLD PLAYER OPTIONS[/h1]
[previewyoutube=PpFCjqMi6xg;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]NEW PLAYER OPTIONS[/h1]
[previewyoutube=bhlCgPvCaF8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

That concludes the new additions to the movement system. Once again, we hope that you love these new additions as much as we do. Update 0.1.1 will be the first, but also a really big update for Panther VR, so we can’t wait to set it live! Let us know what you think!

- Jesse

notes.title: Panther VR - Dev Blog 8# [New Weapons System]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/ab97d40d45706a8e1b9fc45a63c0bc9f03cdf77a.png[/img]
[h1]Hi Everyone,[/h1]

It is time to talk more about the changes coming to the weapons interaction. As you may have noticed in our previous Dev Blogs, we are working a huge overhaul of the core mechanics. We have a full rework of the interaction system and added a physical inventory system in the form of a backpack. With big changes like that, weapon interaction and handling cannot stay behind. Combat is an important part of Panther VR and it deserved some extra attention as well.*

[i][b]*[THIS DEVBLOG WAS ALREADY POSTED ON OUR DISCORD AND REDDIT ON 4TH OF September][/b][/i]

Let's start with the way you grab your weapons. In the current version of Panther VR, you needed to open a quick-select menu with a top button. This quick select menu showed you 2 weapon choices, and with the press of another button, you could switch to the gadgets. With a quick swipe to the weapon you wanted you were able to wield it in your hand. We choose this system at an early stage of development to complement the fast-paced combat of Panther VR. We thought it would be a fast way to switch weapons during combat, however, it also gives the game an arcade game feel.

[h2]OLD WEAPONS INVENTORY[/h2]

[previewyoutube=M_cvtK3LmGc;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

Based on our own experience in the game and on a lot of feedback from the community we decided to give this system a full overhaul. While the old system was more fast-faced, we are moving to a more “realistic approach”. That is why we are introducing a physical weapons system. All your weapons will be stored on your body/belt and the quick select system will be removed from the game. We have added 2 belt slots (left/right) for small firearms and gadgets. Those who played VRDK should be familiar with this system, except we build this one specifically for Panther VR. You can quickly draw and store your pistol from your hip. It is even possible to change slots.

[h2]NEW PISTOL SLOTS[/h2]

[previewyoutube=5YuuFAg1vj4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

The rifle and large weapons work a little bit differently from the small ones. They need a large weapon slot to store them. You can find the large weapon slot on your lower back (lower front also works) just below your backpack. With a quick motion, you can swipe the rifle from your back, ready to use it! The rifle won’t fit in your belt slots. This new physical inventory system was a big community request and we can’t wait to bring it to you in the next update. It feels so much better to store them on your belt than to grab them from a quick-select menu.

[h2]NEW RIFLE SLOTS[/h2]

[previewyoutube=ZyWcdibRivk;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

The physical inventory is not the only big change to weapons, next up is physical reloading and handling. In the old system, reloading was very simple. When the gun was empty you just needed to press the button to release the mag, and then you needed to bring your gun to your belt to reload. This old system is also in for a big change. Besides the fact that the weapons are now properly in your hands, you can also interact with them.


[h2]OLD WEAPONS RELOAD[/h2]

[previewyoutube=f8g6_hEkAaY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

To reload your weapons in the new system, you still only need one button to eject the mag. Then you need to grab a new clip from your ammo belt (instead of moving the weapon to your belt) and physically put the new mag in your weapon. Once inserted, you need to pull back the slide of your weapons to put a bullet in the chamber. You can eject a mag or cock your gun whenever you want. The physical system makes it even possible to choose your own reload method: Put your mag on a table, slam your gun on the mag, hit out the old mag with a new one, or throw your mag into the air and catch it with your gun. There is also a chance for weapon handling. Shooting your rifle from the hip now adds more recoil, so it is more beneficial to use them with 2 hands.

[h2]NEW PISTOL RELOAD[/h2]

[previewyoutube=k2kh5sSoEKM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h2]NEW RIFLE RELOAD[/h2]

[previewyoutube=z_jDdOfwADQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h2]RELOAD TRICK[/h2]

[previewyoutube=uYqaXE9Bvpo;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

With this new physical reloading system, we also want to introduce a new system as well. In the old version, you had unlimited bullets, but we are also including ammunition with the new update. You can no longer indefinitely grab mags from your belt. Each mag takes a certain amount from your total munition count. So your bullet may run out if you are not careful. We are also adding bullet types, starting with a pistol and rifle ammo, meaning all weapons of the same type share the same ammo. For example, If we add more pistols to the game, they would all share the same bullet type. Now you may think: what will happen when I run out of ammo? Well, you can also find ammo boxes around the level to refill your ammo belt! Hopefully one day, you might even be able to “borrow” some ammo from a guard.

[h2]AMMO SYSTEM[/h2]

[previewyoutube=uZPogh5tomU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

This concluded the Dev blog about the weapons. We would love to hear your thoughts on these new features! We are making good progress and we can't wait to get you hands on the new update!

[h3]- Jesse[/h3]

notes.title: Panther VR - Dev Blog 7# [New Backpack System]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/aedd19b3b746136a1d482ab04d09063a5ee52141.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

It is time for another dev update! Last post we showed you the new interaction system and the direction that we are taking for Panther VR. We are very great full for all the positive reactions, and we can't wait for the release of the 0.1.1 update. Until that moment, we keep you updated on the progress and what is to come. This week we will share some insight into a very big addition to the game: a new inventory system!*

[b][i]*[THIS DEVBLOG WAS ALREADY POSTED ON OUR DISCORD AND REDDIT ON 20TH OF AUGUST ][/i][/b]

In the current version of Panther VR you are able to find weapons and loot across the level. You could pick them up, but if you wanted to bring a wrench with you, you needed to hold it in your hands the whole time. Loot also just disappeared into an unknown dimension when you picked it up. These things are all about to change with the first update.

Introducing: the Backpack! The Backpack serves as a physical inventory system in which you can store items, melee weapons, and Loot. The Backpack is located behind your head and can be grabbed by holding down the grip button.

[h1]GRAB BACKPACK[/h1]
[previewyoutube=EswNY-DkivU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

Inside your Backpack you can find a certain amount of slots for Items and melee weapons, sorted into different tabs. You can now bring your favorite screwdriver anywhere you want, stock up on some toilet paper, or create your own collection of mugs. You can bring all small items with you including Melee weapons and loot. So next time you come across a guard, there might be something very useful in your backpack.

[h1]GRAB ITEMS[/h1]
[previewyoutube=epYMYid2bLY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

Once an item is placed in your backpack, you can hover over it to show its name and type. If you see an item you need, just grab it out of your backpack, and it is ready to use!

[h1]TAKE ITEMS[/h1]
[previewyoutube=8LdJFaWLsLs;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

We also included a Quick store and Auto store function to the backpack. When you grab the backpack, you can also put items in the auto slot at the top which are automatically stored in the first empty slot. For even more convenience you can also use the Quick store function. Without holding the backpack, you can just grab and put and item behind your head to automatically store it in your backpack!


[h1]QUICK STORE[/h1]
[previewyoutube=-rgao0gele0;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


All the items you can store in your backpack fall under these categories (for the time being):

[b]Items:[/b] Stuff you can find around the level, from toilet paper to mug and office supplies.  You can throw these to distract the guards, and with update 0.1.2 hopefully, you will be able to stun them, or maybe disarm them. 
[b]Melee Weapons:[/b] Some items serve as a melee weapon, like a screwdriver or a wrench. These melee weapons will instantly Kill or knock out a guard. 
[b]Loot:[/b] You can find valuable stuff like smartphones or wallets around the level. You can take them to your hideout to sell them for a special currency. 

Keep in mind that more content and features will be added later to the game and are still conceptual, like the stun with items or maybe durability for melee weapons. The bag pack system on its basis will bring plenty of new possibilities to think of.

At this moment storing items will not have a disadvantage on your movement speed or noise. However, there will be a limited amount of storage for items and loot. In the current version, you can take as many loots as you could find, but with the backpack, you will think of what you will take back to your hideout. Your backpack will be emptied out once you return for a mission. 

So there will be large storage for loot at your hideout, but this might be added in a later update. Meaning that in 0.1.1 loot in your backpack will sell automatically once the mission ends.
We can't wait to add more function to items and stuff in later updates. Like using a screwdriver to unscrew an air vent, or to pick locks, etc. That is why we would love to hear ideas from the community! 

We hope that these new additions show that we really want to improve the game. The backpack is a big new feature and together with the new interaction system and some stuff we are still going to show you, the game already feels like a different experience. Hopefully, it will bring Panther VR one big step closer to the stealth experience you all dream off. 

This concludes our Dev blog about the new inventory system. We hope you like the progress so far, and we can't wait to show you more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/fb7fced9b6b8d772324534c788a9a17a8b241e77.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone,[/h1]

Hope that everyone is still feeling good. We have been hard at work on Panther VR after its release nearly a month ago. After a bit of a rocky launch, we were able to resolve the major issues with 2 big hotfixes. But now we are steaming ahead on for the first big update for Panther VR: the Interaction update. We can’t wait to show you some stuff that we have been working on, and what the main direction will be for the 0.1.1 update. This update will include some big changes and improvements to the game, and we will be sharing these changes in the next few weeks with small dev updates on the discord, steam forum, and Reddit. So without further ado, let’s talk about the new update and what is to come! *

[b][i]*[THIS DEVBLOG WAS ALREADY POSTED ON OUR DISCORD AND REDDIT ON 5TH OF AUGUST ][/i][/b]

The first update will be the interaction update. While Panther VR has a level of interaction, it is very rough and does not live up to the standards of current VR games. You were only able to grab a very limited amount of items, and even if you would pick them up, they didn’t fit well in your hands. The arms felt wonky, and the finger movement (added in a hotfix) still did not feel as good as it should be. The core of VR is player interaction. You need to feel your presence in the game, by grabbing and interacting with objects the way you would expect.

That is why we decided to focus our attention on the interaction system. The old system was an evolvement of the one in VRDK. But after a year of tweaking, it became a bit of a mess and it reached its limits. That is why we are removing the old system of the game, and are building on a whole new player and interaction system. This is as much work as it sounds. Everything related to the player needs to be rebuilt or reworked, but we believe that this will greatly change and improve the overall experience of Panther VR.

In this first dev update, we are going to talk about the hands. We’ve added some gifs to this post to showcase some of the changes in the new update. First let's take a look at the Arms, or better: the lack of Arms. While we really love to see the arms, the current ones felt really clunky and were more of a distraction than an addition. This is why we decided to remove the arms from the game so that we can add them back in a later stage, but only if we can make them perfect. So from update 0.1.1, we are using hands only. We’ve remodeled, reskinned, and adjusted the size of the hands. We also added a new finger movement system for better immersion. The finger movement now directly mirrors the one you might see in Oculus home.

[h1]OLD Interaction[/h1]
[previewyoutube=WekPK_M4kGE;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[h1]NEW Interaction[/h1]
[previewyoutube=OY-qKDxqhy4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

One of the biggest changes however is the item interaction. You are now able to fully grasp the items you pick up. Every item has its unique pose while grabbing, so no more floating items or strangely placed fingers. We’ve also added full physics to each item, so you will be able to knock stuff over or build small towers out of soda cans. It is still possible to grab objects once your hands are near them, but we also reworked the ranged system as well. Complimented by a GUI and hover over the indicator, items will now float smoothly into your hands once you grab them from a distance. 


We have plenty of more stuff coming up in this new update, and we can’t wait to talk about them more in the next blog. 

Thanks again for your support, You are all amazing!

[h1]Welcome to Panther VR Early Access![/h1]

Hi Everyone,

We hope you are all safe and well.

With great pleasure, we want to welcome you all to the Panther VR early Access! After a successful Kickstarter campaign and months of hard work, we can finally release the first Early Access version of Panther VR to the public.

First of all, we want to thank all of our Backers and our amazing community for testing the game and providing us with a lot of positive feedback and support. Now the time has come to release Panther VR to the public and to start our Early Access adventure together with our community. The 0.1.0 Version contains the base mechanics of the game to showcase our vision and future direction of the game. You can start a randomly generated mission from your hideout, use weapons and gadgets to evade security, go full stealth or guns blazing to get to the objective, find loot hidden all around the heist locations. 

Panther VR aims to bring the stealth-action genre to VR. We want to have a high focus on sandbox mechanics. For the player to discover their own route in open levels, choose their own playstyle with different approaches, and to play with the environment, gadgets, and weapons to aid them in their heists. All current and future content is added with a sandbox in mind and is largely based on feedback and suggestions from our community. 

We have huge plans for Panther VR, and a big list of content, reworks, and ideas for future updates. While we are super happy that Panther VR is finally open for the public, we also want to add, that this is still a VERY EARLY version of Panther VR. While the base game is present and we are very proud of what we have made already, it might still be a bit rough around the edges at some points and the game may contain some bugs. Please keep this in mind when buying the game, but if you do decide to check it out, it will help us out to improve the game immensely and hope you will see our vision and love for the game. If you want to help us out even more: you can share your feedback and suggestions with us in the Discord, together we can make this game into something amazing!

Thank you all so much for supporting the game and we hope you will enjoy this journey with us!

Have fun!

[b]-Wolfdog Team[/b]

[h1]Added: The Hideout [MAIN HUB][/h1]

The Guild provided your crew with their own Hideout. This secret base of operations is located in an abandoned warehouse and is repurposed with the following high tech equipment: An operation center for planning your missions, an armory for your weapons and gadgets, and a garage for your escape Vehicle. It will also be a perfect place to relax between dangerous missions.

The player Hideout will serve as the main hub of the game, you'll start your game in the hideout and it will be the location where you'll select your missions in the operation center. Since it is still an early version of the game, your hideout will only contain the mission selection screen, but many more functionalities will be included in later updates, such as a functional armory for weapon and gadget customization.

[h1]Added: Facility N4 [HEIST][/h1]

Welcome to Facility N4, a research facility located between the mountains and in a dense forest. This highly secured location is the home of many secret experiments, ranging from the creation of pharmaceutical samples to the productions of weapon prototypes. Its large open laboratory is crowded with security, but the machines and canisters should provide enough cover for our agent. Gain access through the loading dock, or go straight for the Main Lobby. Make sure you don’t forget to explore the offices for useful items and loot.  

Facility N4 is one of the first Heist locations in the game. Let me explain what a heist location means for the game. When you select a mission, it will take place at a heist location. These are prebuilt open-world locations. This means that the location will look the same, however, your selected mission will change a lot of variables at this level. Security will be in different locations, start and end locations will be different, loot will spawn in different locations, etc. Each heist location is also designed as a fully open level. You can always choose your own path and approach for each time you play a heist. 

With the combination of level randomization, and open level design, each level will have countless combinations and approaches and a high replayability factor. 

[b]Notible level locations:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Laboratory[/b]
[*] [b]Loading Dock[/b]
[*] [b]Visitors lobby[/b]
[*] [b]Research offices[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Added: First Heists [MISSIONS][/h1]

In a distant future, ruled by international Corporations, there is always a struggle for power. Most power can be bought with money, everything else can be stolen. This is where the “Guild” comes into place. An international secret organization of master thieves, working for the highest bidder.  These companies are always interested in obtaining prototypes, samples, or top-secret documents from their competitors. That is where you come in.

You can take on missions provided by the Guild. They can be selected in the Hideout. The first missions you can play are Heists. A Heist always has one primary Objective: steal the main object. This sounds easy on paper, but the main objective is always locked in a secure room. So your first goal is to gain access to this secured room. This can be done in two distinct ways: 

[b]1) STEALTH [/b]The first is the stealth approach. You can choose to complete two secondary objectives to gain access to the vault. The first and only secondary objective currently in the game is to override power to the vault door. More variants will be added in later updates, for example: hacking a terminal. Once these secondary objectives are completed, the vault door will unlock and the main objective will be for the taking. 

[b]2) LOUD [/b]You can also choose a more direct and loud approach. Instead of completing the secondary objectives, you can also place a lasercutter on the vault door. This lasercutter will gradually cut a hole in the door, but it will also trigger the built-in security system, which will sound the alarm. To be on the lookout for incoming armed forces, and try to protect the lasercutter al all cost. When a hole is cut with your lasers, your final barrier will be gone, and the objective can be looted. 

[quote=] [b]Developer Comment:[/b] While the stealth approach is always the first and suggested way to go, (netting you more rewards in later updates), the more forceful approach is also needed when the alarm is triggered in stealth approach, and you didn’t complete the secondary objectives. Once you obtained the primary objective, it is time to head to the Getaway van. Each Heist will be randomly generated and is sorted on difficulty.  In the current version, there are 2 (random) generated test missions before we integrate a fully-fledged mission system in a later update. [/quote]

Everybody has its own preference when it comes to movement in VR. That is why we already added a variety of movement options to choose from. For your main movement, you can choose between movement with the stick, or our own “Arm Swing” system. (Same as in VR Dungeon Knight). [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/ae7eca822a90cabc7bf0d3602d28741efd3318f3.png[/img]


[h1]Added: FELDT M33 [WEAPON][/h1]

When a plan does not work out as expected and you need to engage in full combat, the Feldt will be your best friend. This Guild-issued assault rifle comes with a good fire rate and a decent-sized magazine. Equipped with Iron sights, it can be precise on a good range. This assault rifle can be held with both hands.

[b]Weapon statistics:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Can be wielded with both hands[/b] 
[*] [b]Very useful for Loud approach[/b]
[*] [b]Very Fast fire[/b]
[*] [b]Normal range[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f5468afb9398e2c20ca99951ba4cc3d115d39ec9.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Grappling Hook [GADGET][/h1]

A good item for traversal is important for any thief. Use the grappling hook to get yourself up too hard to reach locations. You can find hooks and ledges scattered around the heist location. Shoot a rope from a distance and climb up on the rooftops. The grappling gun grants access to new routes and different approaches. 

[b]Gadget statistics:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Shoot a climbing rope from a distance[/b]  (More functions added in future update)
[*] [b]Opens up new routes[/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/8ddbb4f0e951997ab20cb5cb5c3572ff10f5ce9f.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Scout Drone [GADGET][/h1]

The more you know about your surroundings, the better. Make use of the Scout drone, and scout ahead before entering. It’s a small two-wheeled drone and comes equipped with a camera. The scouting drone can reach new places through small vents and can mark guard locations with its camera. The drone cannot be spotted by security, so it very useful for gathering intel. 

[b]Gadget statistics:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Use the drone to scout ahead[/b]  (More functions added in future update)
[*] [b]Marks guards[/b]
[*] [b]Can go through small vents[/b]
[*] [b]Can be used to hack Security Routers[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/59b97a0591aee9d3bf874f937957be206c957bc5.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f9f52bb465d82c4fd351245c46a785b440e65302.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Loot [COLLECT][/h1]

Exploration is key as a Thief. Take a good look around during your heist to find many useful and valuable items. I’m sure nobody will miss their valuable belongings right? Scattered around the heist locations you can find loot. Pick them up and sell them for a good profit. Some extra money, above the initial mission awards, will always come in handy. 


[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Find randomized loot all across the level[/b] 
[*] [b]Gain some extra cash for what you collect[/b]
[*] [b]Loot comes with a different value[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/eacc23333567a57c40fac9f20b567e5fe9f8554c.png[/img]


[h1]Added: (Non)Lethal Weapons [ITEM][/h1]


Your own weapons aren't the only ones that can be useful during your heist. If you are creative enough you can use some items you find throughout the heist locations. A pointy screwdriver can be a deadly throwing weapon in the right hands, and the guard will take a good nap after a kiss to the face from a wrench. You can use items as lethal weapons to dispatch guards in creative methods. (non-lethal takedowns will be added in a future update)

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Find items during a heist to use as a weapon[/b] 
[*] [b]Use a screwdriver as a deadly throwing weapon[/b]
[*] [b]Hit a guard unconscious with a heavy wrench[/b] (more items will be added in a future update)
[*] [b]Blow up propane canisters[/b] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/7b0a4bc5d71a7945bb98cff737745f7875fc51fc.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Climbing/vents [ENVIRONMENT][/h1]

When you run into an obstacle during your heist, you might need to look for a different route. Use rain pipes, ladders, and ropes to take the high road to your objective. Large air vents may also prove useful to navigate around the location, it is also a good place to hide, for when the guards start looking around. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Use pipes, ladders and ropes to climb[/b] 
[*] [b]Sneak inside with the use of an Airvent[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/f2acb6ff5617cae6156377f59653acfc08e2ece8.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Cardboard Box [ITEM][/h1]

Sometimes, the best place to hide is in plain sight. We got a Solid tip from a very experienced agent that a cardboard box will do the trick. I’m sure there must be some boxes laying around you can use. The key is to stay very quiet and don’t move. The guard won’t blink an eye from a distance, but they might be suspicious from a shorter range.

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Hide in a Cardboardbox[/b] 
[*] [b]Sneaky like a snake[/b]
[*] [b]Don’t move![/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/69c46205b30145288d5dae830434c65e449f7bb2.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/cf60ae2e3e02334b4b2646e162877c38408a0879.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Security Guard [GUARD][/h1]

Müller international security [MSec] is responsible for the protection and security of high priority locations. They enlist and deploy trained security guards to patrol around important targets. Be on the lookout for these guards. They follow a strict patrol route, but they will also investigate anything suspicious. When they find something that confirms their suspicion they will call out for backup, or even sound the alarm. Do your best to avoid these guards, and only use force if necessary. If so, try to hide the body if you can. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Avoid detection[/b] 
[*] [b]Patrols a set route[/b] (A.I will be reworked in future update)
[*] [b]Will investigate anything suspicious[/b]
[*] [b]Can be taken out[/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/dbb0d00af37fd6d6b98f593b557a0cc615fad492.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Heavy Guard [GUARD][/h1]

When a normal Security guard doesn’t suffice, bring in the Heavy Guards. These Heavy guards are all padded up, and come equipped with bulletproof helmets, which prevents headshots. They can take a lot more damage than normal security guards, so try to avoid them at all costs. However, if you can get close enough, a well-placed screwdriver might do the trick. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Armored, can take a lot of damage[/b] 
[*] [b]Patrols a set route[/b]
[*] [b]Will investigate anything suspicious[/b]
[*] [b]Vulnerable for melee. [/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a34ac935685b336707e7b96f8876e50794c3be53.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Security Camera [SEC SYSTEM][/h1]

Security cameras are the first line of defense. They can be found all over the location, and they always scan for anything suspicious. Close track their movement and locations, and try to stay out of their sight. They won’t detect noise, and a well-timed shot can take them out of service. However, guards aren’t so keen on finding broken security systems. 

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]On the lookout for intruders[/b] 
[*] [b]Won't detect noise[/b]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/60cdb53f9f1af84a3226f9155a0759e6205e9e1c.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Laserfence [BASIC SEC][/h1]

A very efficient and common security system is the Laser fence. These strategically placed fences are used to keep intruders out. Small points emit painful lasers to form a large grid, to block off a certain route. The lasers are calibrated on the presence of Guards and SWAT, which will make them immune to the effect of the lasers. However, if an intruder touches the laser grid, they will receive a painful shock, and the gate will sound a short alarm for any surrounding guards.  

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Blocks route for intruders[/b] 
[*] [b]Very painfully when touched[/b]
[*] [b]Calibrated to Guards and Police[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/601f31a944e1756f0e74de1124cb06f792a437dd.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Security Routers [BASIC SEC][/h1]

All these different security systems need a way to communicate with each other. That is where the Security routers come in to play. Every system is linked together with everything else in a room. Locate a security router in a room, and try to disable with your drone, or to destroy them with brute force. Once the routers are deactivated, the other systems in the room will pose no threat, but a sudden system failure won’t go unnoticed.


[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Controls all security systems in a room[/b] 
[*] [b]Can be deactivated[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/28551a1b7a6cb599b4dc61634719bb70fb8db811.png[/img]


[h1]Added: Keycards [BASIC SEC][/h1]

One of the best things you can do to avoid an intrusion is to lock your doors. That is why some of the doors are locked shut with a Keycard panel. These doors can only be opened with the right access. It is also possible to gain access to a locked door with a borrowed keycard. Or just look around, there is always a way to get inside.

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Some doors are locked with keycard[/b] 
[*] [b]Guards and Police can use these doors[/b]
[*] [b]You can gain access with the right keycard[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/a768e497bd3296cc3cbe90256ab695f4e51f3427.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/bec3b8a8b80f6acce5014201b85dc68b4112477f.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35886416/9d42a0b3a8d63a285f8ae6e55b3c7d374f7db829.png[/img]


[h1]Added: SWAT [POLICE] [/h1]

When your stealthy approach proves unsuccessful, and the alarm is raised, then the Police arrive at the scene. Trained SWAT agents will storm the location and will try to neutralize any intruder insight. Once this police raid takes place, there will be no turning back to normal. Armored SWAT with a deadly assault rifle will keep coming until the player leaves a location with the escape van, or when they are killed. Try to ward off all the attackers and defend the laser cutter at all costs.
